{{Disambig}} '''Donatello''' is the [[Ninja Turtles (team)|Turtle]] that is commonly accepted as the smartest of the group, specifically in matters related to scientific pursuits and technology. He is an accomplished inventor who is able to develop multiple advanced devices with minimal resources, which he devotes to helping both himself and his brothers. In most incarnations, he wears a purple bandana and wields a [[Bō]] staff. ==Comic characters== 2500563-turtle124.jpg|'''{{Miragelink|Donatello}}'''

{{Disambig}} '''Leonardo''' - named in honor of the great artist of the Renaissance [[Leonardo da Vinci]] - is typically the most senior of the {{suflink|team|Ninja Turtles}} and typically presented as their leader due to his commanding personality and his serious and mature nature throughout the franchise. Among his brothers, he is the most ordered and disciplined, and also possesses a very strong bond with his father/mentor, [[Splinter]]. He is often depicted wearing a blue [[bandana]] in most media and wielding twin [[Katana]]s. {{disambig}} '''Splinter''' (スプリンター ''Supurintā'') is a [[mutant]] [[Rats|rat]] and is an important character in all incarnations of the [[Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (franchise)|''Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles'']] franchise, serving as the teacher/[[sensei]], martial arts instructor, and adoptive father of the {{suflink|team|Ninja Turtles}}. In some incarnations, he is a mutated or [[reincarnation|reincarnated]] [[Hamato Yoshi]]; in others, he was Yoshi's pet rat who is sometimes known as '''Hamato Splinter'''. Splinter's name and character is a reference to ''[[w:c:marvel:Daredevil|Daredevil]]'' character {{linkWikipedia|Stick (comics)|Stick}}.[[Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: The Ultimate Visual History]][[Turtle Power: The Definitive History of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles]] ==Comic characters== Splinter (Mirage) profile.jpg|'''{{miragelink|Hamato Splinter}}'''

Indomitable Will |weapon = Bladed armor |occupation = [[Ninja]] and leader |affiliation = {{BatmanvsTMNTlink|Foot Clan}} |species = {{Char Species|Human}} |bandana = |era = {{Char Appear|batmanvstmnt}} |debut = [[Batman vs. Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles]] |voice = [[Andrew Kishino]]}}'''[[Oroku Saki]]''', known also as '''[[Shredder]]''', is the nemesis of the {{BatmanvsTMNTlink|Ninja Turtles}}, the leader of the {{BatmanvsTMNTlink|Foot Clan}}, and the primary antagonist in the film [[Batman vs. Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles]]. ==History== Shredder made an alliance with {{BatmanvsTMNTlink|Ra's al Ghul}} and the {{BatmanvsTMNTlink|League of Assassins}}, out of his desire for the immortality granted by a Lazarus Pit. In exchange for the Pit, the Foot Clan would provide {{BatmanvsTMNTlink|mutagen}} stolen from [[Techno Cosmic Research Institute|T.C.R.I]], and a means of spreading the substance over the entirety of Gotham City. To this end, Shredder stole the mutagen, and then went to Gotham to build a {{BatmanvsTMNTlink|mutagen-disseminating device}}. The Turtles followed him to Gotham, but were unable to stop the Foot Clan from stealing equipment from [[S.T.A.R. Labs]], [[LexCorp]], and [[Powers Industrial]]. When the Foot attempted to steal a cloud seeder from {{BatmanvsTMNTlink|Wayne Enterprises}}, they were unexpectedly thwarted by {{BatmanvsTMNTlink|Bruce Wayne|Batman}}, who defeated all of Shredder's ninja before fighting him individually. They were pretty evenly matched until Shredder attacked him with the [[sato oshi strike]], which badly injured Batman and briefly exhausted Shredder. Tensions began to rise between Ra's al Ghul and Shredder because of this setback, and Shredder demonstrated the effectiveness of the mutagenic ooze by having {{BatmanvsTMNTlink|Baxter Stockman}} inject a League ninja with it. He then went to {{BatmanvsTMNTlink|Arkham Asylum}} with Ra's al Ghul, where the two killed the entire security staff. Shredder was displeased by this particular venture, believing it to be a waste of time they could be using to get the cloud seeder, and disdainful of the "freaks" imprisoned in Arkham. However, after Ra's al Ghul had obtained the [[Joker Venom]] formula from the {{BatmanvsTMNTlink|Joker}}, Shredder paid the clown with a canister of mutagen. The Joker's subsequent actions served as an effective distraction for the Turtles and Batman, during which time the {{BatmanvsTMNTlink|Oswald Cobblepot|Penguin}} obtained the cloud seeder and delivered it to Ra's al Ghul and Shredder. When ordered to deal with the Penguin's compensation, Shredder confirmed that there was no money to pay him with, even as the Foot executed Penguin's followers. He threatened to kill the Penguin as well if he did not leave. Shredder and Ra's al Ghul then fortified themselves in [[Ace Chemicals]] to finish building the device, and mutated a number of both League and Foot ninja to protect the building. However, the Turtles and Batman managed to break through and engage their enemies, with Batman determined to have another opportunity to fight Shredder after his previous stalemate. Shredder was an effective foe for Batman, fighting him on equal footing and even seemingly gaining the upper hand. As he prepared the sato oshi strike once again, Batman temporarily confused him by saying "Cowabunga," allowing Raphael time to slam into Shredder's head, knocking off his mask. Batman then attacked Shredder again, punching him repeatedly until Shredder's face was bloodied. He stated that the League and the Foot were his, and that his enemies had no way of stopping him. As he spoke, the flaming remains of the mutagen-disseminating device fell through the ceiling, throwing Shredder into a vat of Joker Venom. The Ace Chemicals building then collapsed and exploded, seemingly killing him. However, {{BatmanvsTMNTlink|Leonardo}} cast doubt on the idea, pointing out that Shredder had seemingly died before. Leonardo's supposition was proved to be correct, as Shredder later crawled from the remains of the Ace Chemicals building. However, the over exposure to the Joker Venom had caused him to become a partial duplicate of the Joker. == Powers and Abilities == === Powers === * '''Sato Oshi Strike:''' === Abilities === * '''Master Combatant: '''Shredder is highly skilled in hand to hand combat. He fought evenly against Batman twice and sometimes even briefly gained the upper hand. * '''Master Acrobat:''' * '''Blade Mastery:''' * '''Stealth Mastery:''' * '''Peak Human Condition:''' * '''Gifted Intelligence:''' ** '''Master Tactician:''' ** '''Leadership:''' * '''Intimidation:''' * '''Indomitable Will:''' ==Trivia== *The claw marks on Shredder's face are a homage to the [[Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1990 film)|1990 movie]], in which [[Splinter (Golden Harvest/Imagi)|Splinter's]] attack had left scars on [[Oroku Saki (Golden Harvest/Imagi)|his enemy's]] cheek.
